objective: Verify the Vitals module can perform the requirement-specified primary action in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
verifies: verifies nominal completion of the requirement-specified primary action and resulting system state update in the Vitals module
protocol: Open the HealthCore EHR test environment with the test user logged in and the Vitals module active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and state change.
acceptance_criteria: An audit log entry is created.
